blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: boundary test — Input at or near a valid limit.
erroneous test — Input outside permitted requirements.
expected result — Predicted correct output for a test.
regression — New change breaks previously working behaviour.

blocks.title: State the valid range
blocks.text: The specification permits whole-number marks from 0 through 100 inclusive.

blocks.title: Choose targeted tests
blocks.text: Normal value 50; valid boundaries 0 and 100; invalid just beyond boundaries −1 and 101.

blocks.title: Write expected results
blocks.text: A useful test log records input, expected outcome and actual outcome; a mismatch is evidence of a fault.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Test just below and at the lower limit: 7 rejected, 8 accepted.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model and explain
blocks.text: Also test a normal 14, upper boundary 20, and 21 rejected.
